audit.why: 7/10 with Fiora owning Levels 4-5 and 2+ items is right: Lunge drops from 13s to 9.5s across those ranks while Trundle gains nothing new, and Grand Challenge plus vital healing beats a Frozen Domain grind once she has items.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 4-5 spike says 'respect her Riposte (W) timing or she stuns you mid-Subjugate'. Riposte only stuns if it parries an immobilizing effect; against Trundle's kit it can only slow.
audit.why: Riot's Riposte text: 'Fiora parries all incoming damage and disables for a short time, then stabs in a direction. This stab slows the first enemy champion hit, or stuns them if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect with this ability.' Trundle's kit is a slow (Chomp), a zone (Frozen Domain), terrain plus a slow (Pillar of Ice) and a targeted steal (Subjugate) — none of them immobilize, so she cannot get the stun off you alone. She needs your jungler's CC for it.
audit.corrected: All three 'Riposte stuns you' lines corrected, with the condition stated so the player knows when it does become a stun.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three things. (a) Riposte is described as stunning Trundle in breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5], spikes[1] and wants.foe[1] — see point 3. (b) Lunge is never named; it is called 'her Q dash' and its 13s rank-1 cooldown never appears, which hides the fact that Pillar of Ice is impassable terrain and stops the only gap-closer she has. (c) The vital heal is never mentioned even though the interaction file flags this matchup for anti-heal.
audit.why: Riot Data Dragon. Lunge: 13/11.25/9.5/7.75/6, 400 range, 'lunges in a direction and stabs a nearby enemy... applying on-hit effects' — a dash, and on-hit, which is why she itemises attack speed. Duelist's Dance: 'If she hits the Vital, she restores Health and gains Move Speed.' Grand Challenge: 'Fiora and her allies in the area are healed over the next few seconds.' Riposte 24/22/20/18/16 — the longest cooldown in the matchup and the whole reason a baited W is a free fight.
audit.corrected: Riposte's real condition and 24s stated, Lunge named with its 13s cooldown and Pillar named as the terrain that stops it, and the vital heal written in as the anti-heal reason.

audit.whatIsWrong: Riposte is the tracked cooldown on ten lines and its duration never appears.
audit.why: Riposte is 24s at rank 1 — the largest window in the lane. Lunge is 13s at rank 1, Bladework 11s, Grand Challenge 110s.
audit.corrected: 24s and 13s now stated in the cooldown block, the dos, the report, the spike and mid.

edits.after: - Fiora Riposte: 24s at rank 1 — parries damage, but only stuns if it blocks hard CC. Bait it.

edits.after: Chomp saps her AD, cutting her autos and the on-hit that Lunge carries — bite before she reaches a Vital

edits.before: Chomp on level 1 is your strongest opening — the AD steal directly reduces how hard her vitals hit because vital damage scales off her AD. Hit her on every attempt to last-hit and let King's Tribute heal off dying minions so she cannot outsustain you through poke. At level 2, drop Frozen Domain the moment she steps up: the movement speed lets you stick to her and deny the Q repositioning she uses to chain vitals. She has no reliable sustain, so every trade where you land two or three Chomp-enhanced autos inside the W zone is a net win even if she procs one vital on the way out.
edits.after: Chomp on level 1 is your strongest opening — the AD sap directly cuts her auto damage and the on-hit that Lunge carries. Hit her on every attempt to last-hit and let King's Tribute heal off dying minions so she cannot outsustain you through poke. At level 2, drop Frozen Domain the moment she steps up: the movement speed lets you stick to her and deny the Lunge repositioning she uses to chain vitals. Every Vital she lands heals her, so Grievous Wounds earns its slot here — and any trade where you land two or three Chomp-enhanced autos inside the W zone is a net win even if she takes one vital on the way out.

edits.before: From levels 4 through 5 Fiora's Q is lower cooldown, her vitals reset faster after procs, and her Riposte window is sharp enough to stun you if you pattern your Chomp at the same interval every trade — mix up the timing so she cannot predict the spell cast to Riposte. Frozen Domain is still your equalizer: if she dashes into your W zone to proc a back vital, you get the movement speed to cut her off while she is committed. Do not fight her when your Pillar is down — it is your only tool to prevent her from disengaging after burning her Q cooldown. At level 6 the dynamic shifts back: Subjugate cast immediately after she uses Riposte on an auto means she has no parry left, you drain her armor, and the fight inside Frozen Domain is yours.
edits.after: From levels 4 through 5 Fiora's Lunge falls toward 9.5s, her vitals reset faster after procs, and she can Riposte a Chomp if you cast it on the same beat every trade — mix up the timing so she cannot read you. What she cannot do is stun you with it: Riposte only stuns when it blocks an immobilizing effect, and nothing in your kit is one, so from you the stab is just a slow. Frozen Domain is still your equalizer: if she Lunges into your W zone to reach a back vital, the movement speed lets you cut her off while she is committed. Do not fight with Pillar down — it is impassable terrain and the only thing that stops the Lunge. At level 6, Subjugate the moment Riposte is spent: 24 seconds at rank 1 means the parry is gone for the entire fight.

edits.before: With Trinity Force and a second item you consistently win the extended 1v1 because Subjugate steals a meaningful chunk of armor even from a duelist, and Frozen Domain's sustained healing out-paces her Grand Challenge lifesteal unless she is very far ahead. The matchup stays competitive throughout — she has true damage that never stops mattering, and a well-timed Riposte on your Subjugate cast completely reverses the all-in. Split-push into her: you win the sustained fight, she cannot easily kill you under your own W, and Pillar cuts off tower retreats. In team fights target the enemy tank with Subjugate rather than chasing Fiora — she is your lane problem, not your team-fight answer.
edits.after: With Trinity Force and a second item you consistently win the extended 1v1 because Subjugate steals a meaningful chunk of armor even from a duelist, and Frozen Domain's sustained healing out-paces her vital healing unless she is very far ahead. The matchup stays competitive throughout — Grand Challenge heals her and her allies, and a Riposte saved for your commit still eats a full Chomp rotation. Split-push into her: you win the sustained fight, she cannot easily kill you under your own W, and Pillar cuts off tower retreats. In team fights target the enemy tank with Subjugate rather than chasing Fiora — she is your lane problem, not your team-fight answer.

edits.before: Chomp at level 1 immediately drains Fiora's AD, softening the true damage her passive vitals deal — bite her before she can position a vital proc.
edits.after: Chomp at level 1 saps Fiora's AD, softening every auto and the on-hit her Lunge applies — bite her before she can position for a Vital proc.

edits.before: Subjugate immediately after her Riposte is spent on an auto drains her armor for the full fight duration inside Frozen Domain — this is your cleanest kill window all lane.
edits.after: Subjugate immediately after Riposte is spent drains her armor for the full fight inside Frozen Domain, and 24s at rank 1 means it will not come back — your cleanest kill window.

notes: Main correction: the page said five separate times that Riposte stuns Trundle. Riot's text stuns only 'if Fiora blocked an immobilizing effect' — Trundle's kit contains a slow, two zones and a targeted steal, none of which immobilize, so against him the stab is a slow. It does become a stun if she parries your jungler's CC, and that condition is now stated rather than the flat claim. Also named Lunge (13s at rank 1) and pointed Pillar of Ice at it as impassable terrain, and added the vital heal as the anti-heal reason the interaction file flags. NOT written because I could not verify it: whether Riposte blocks the Subjugate cast itself (Riot's text says it parries damage and disables; Subjugate is a targeted stat steal, which is neither) — the old line 'Riposte your Subjugate cast to negate the stat-drain entirely' was removed rather than reworded, since asserting either way would be a guess. Same reason I did not keep 'percent-max-HP true damage' on the passive vitals: Riot's Duelist's Dance text mentions only healing and move speed.
